title: Stairway to Heaven
composer: Jimmy Page & Robert Plant / Led Zeppelin
description: The authentic note-for-note fingerpicked acoustic guitar intro (A-C-E-A...) and Robert Plant's timeless verse melody ("There's a lady who's sure").
generalTip: Key of A minor. The acoustic intro is fingerpicked note-by-note: A, -> C -> E -> a, then the chromatic bass walks down (G# -> G -> F# -> F) while the soprano notes soar.

sections.label: The Iconic Acoustic Arpeggio
tips: 🎸 The unmistakable acoustic fingerpicking — Jimmy Page's legendary opening!
👆 Bar 1: A, -> C -> E -> a, then thumb on G# (bass) with pinky on b, followed by C -> E -> b
✨ Bar 2: G (bass) with c' -> E -> G -> c', then F# (bass) with f# -> D -> A, -> D

sections.label: The Resolution
tips: 🍃 The gentle release: Fmaj7 rolling into G and landing home on Am
👆 Bar 3: Strum/roll [F,Ace] then pluck c -> A -> e, then e -> c -> A into [G,Bd]
🏁 Bar 4: Settle warmly into the full Am chord [A,EAc]
